findings.desc: Docs/tooling sync drift remains: lattice check reports DRIFT with STALE_SAFE .lattice/Lattice.md, .gitignore, .codex/hooks/lattice-scope-pretool.cjs and STALE_LOCAL_EDIT AGENTS.md requiring manual review. This is not an M0 status overclaim, but docs/assets do need syncing before treating the managed project docs/tooling surface as current.

Checker does not verify that budget-lock sourceCellKeys are A4 calibration rows or the declared sourceCellNumber/sourceArm. In validateBudgetLock it only checks that each source key exists and that the source runner snapshot matches the lock. A mutated in-memory budget lock that changes the E2 source from ③/A4 to ⑥/A2prime still passes node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m0-smoke-check.mjs, so the M0 checker can silently accept a circular/post-treatment A2prime budget source and overstate CHK-004 budget-order evidence. Repro: monkeypatch fs.readFileSync for phase1-budget-lock.m0.json to return an E2 lock with sourceCellNumber=⑥, sourceArm=A2prime, sourceReviewerFamily=not_applicable, and sourceCellKeys=["A2prime|task-stratified-01|B01|r01|E2|not_applicable"]; the checker still prints all three pass lines.

CHK-002:happy:0 requires the M0 smoke checker to pass and print assertion counts, but node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m0-smoke-check.mjs prints only three status lines and rg found no assertion/count reporting in m0-smoke-check.mjs. The evidence therefore does not cover the asserted count-output portion of this must verification intent.
